Custom Marine Decking

Choose the pattern, color combination, coverage, and custom details that fit your boat. Sure Step Marine uses an EVA/PE decking material with a high strength PSA (Pressure Sensitive Adhesive) material and takes the project from design through CNC machining and installation.

Make it yours

Custom details built into the deck.

Because the material is designed digitally and CNC machined, the visual details can be incorporated directly into the layout rather than added afterward.

01

Custom Logos

Business logos, boat logos, team marks, or customer-provided artwork incorporated into the design.

02

Boat Names

Add the vessel name or custom lettering as a routed or graphic feature.

03

Fish Rulers

Integrate a measurement ruler directly into an appropriate deck or gunnel section.

04

Borders

Use perimeter lines and accent borders to define panels and tie the entire layout together.

05

Custom Patterns

Go beyond faux teak or diamond with a layout developed specifically for the boat.

06

Construction Approval

Review the layout, colors, pattern, and custom elements before the final material is machined.
